1058.description: Place one arm against a wall and turn away to open the chest. It eases tight pecs.
instructions: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.

1122.description: Rolling out on the straps with a slight side angle, you hit the obliques and deep core.
instructions: Hold the handles kneeling or standing, arms in front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Roll forward and angle your arms toward one side.
Go only as far as you can hold a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Alternate sides each rep.

1186.description: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.
instructions: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

1250.description: A crunch with a weight held behind your head. The extra load makes it harder on the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight behind your head with your elbows out.
Curl your shoulders up, contracting your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

1314.description: Lie face down over a stability ball and lift your chest to extend your back. It strengthens the lower back and glutes in a supported way.
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall or other stable surface.
Position your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将稳定球放在地面上，面朝下躺在上面，臀部放在球上，双脚靠在墙壁或其他稳定的表面上。
将双手放在脑后或交叉在胸前。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的上半身抬离球，伸展你的背部，直到你的身体从头部到脚后跟形成一条直线。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1378.description: A calf stretch where you use a rope to help pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf and the back of the lower leg.
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends of the rope in each hand and place the middle of the rope around the ball of your right foot.
Step back with your left foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Lean forward, keeping your back straight, and gently pull on the rope to stretch your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other leg.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁或坚固物体站立，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
双手握住绳子的两端，将绳子的中间放在右脚掌周围。
左脚向后退一步，脚跟保持在地面上，腿伸直。
身体前倾，保持背部挺直，轻轻拉动绳子以伸展小腿。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一条腿上重复。

1442.description: Holding the top of a dip on parallel bars. It builds the triceps and shoulder stability.
instructions: Grip the parallel bars and press yourself up with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward and lock your shoulders down.
Hold the position with your body still.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Hold for 15-30 seconds and step down.

1506.description: A close-grip curl on an EZ bar with a band adding tension near the top. It targets the biceps.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the EZ bar with a close grip, palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top without swinging.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

1570.description: An explosive vertical jump where you pull your knees into your chest at the top. Great for power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively and tuck both knees toward your chest.
Extend your legs again before landing.
Land softly on bent knees and reset before the next jump.

1634.description: A biceps curl lying on your back with a cable. It keeps tension constant through the whole motion.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
Lie face up on a flat bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the bar up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将直杆连接到低滑轮电缆机上。
面朝上躺在平坦的长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
反手握住杠铃，双手与肩同宽。
充分伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1698.description: Short, springy hops forward that build leg power, elasticity and coordination.
instructions: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent.
Swing your arms and hop forward a short distance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Reset your posture and hop again.
Keep your hops controlled and your chest tall.

1762.description: A pistol squat where you hold onto a support to help with balance. It builds single-leg strength and control on the way to an unassisted pistol.
instructions: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it with one or both hands.
Lift one leg out in front of you and balance on the other.
Sit your hips back and bend your knee, lowering as far as you can control.
Keep your heel down and your knee tracking over your toes.
Press through your foot to stand, using the support only as needed, then switch legs.

1826.description: Pulling your fingers back stretches the muscles on the palm side of your forearm. Great after grip-heavy training or typing.
instructions: Extend one arm forward with your palm facing up or out.
Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers and palm back toward you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1890.description: Low crouch stretch with one heel pushed back to lengthen the Achilles.
instructions: Crouch down with your hands on the floor for balance.
Extend one leg back with the heel down.
Press the heel toward the floor.
Keep your chest lifted.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1954.description: A quad stretch with the back foot resting on a box or bench, opening the front of the thigh.
instructions: Stand facing away from a box or bench and place the top of one foot on it behind you.
Stand tall on the front leg with a soft knee.
Tuck your pelvis and lower the hips slightly until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.
Hold a support for balance if needed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2146.description: A machine version of the hip thrust that loads the glutes with a fixed path of motion.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your upper back against the pad and the belt across your hips.
Plant your feet flat, about hip width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso and thighs are in line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a moment.
Lower with control and repeat, keeping your chin tucked.

2274.description: A rising punch with the right hand aimed upward, using leg drive and a hip turn.
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your right side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your right fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your left hand guarding your chin.
Return to stance and repeat.

2338.description: A side-by-side form check for keeping your butt on the bench during a chest press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips stay planted on the pad and never lift off.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2402.description: A standing hammer curl with an arm blaster to prevent swinging. Targets the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各持一个哑铃，手掌朝向躯干。
保持肘部靠近躯干，并旋转手掌，直到手掌朝前。
这将是您的起始位置。
现在，保持上臂不动，呼气并卷曲哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举重，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
然后，吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复建议的重复次数。

2466.description: A plank-position mountain climber driving knee across the body. Works the abs and obliques, and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right foot off the ground, bringing your right knee towards your left elbow.
Return your right foot to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left foot towards your right elbow.
Continue alternating sides, moving at a controlled pace.
Keep your hips level and avoid lifting your hips too high or sagging them too low.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手直接放在肩膀下方，身体呈一条直线。
启动你的核心并将右脚抬离地面，将右膝移向左肘。
将右脚放回到起始位置，然后将左脚朝向右肘重复该动作。
继续交替两侧，以受控的速度移动。
保持臀部水平，避免臀部抬得太高或下垂得太低。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的呼吸模式。
重复所需的重复次数。

2658.description: A ski-style stride on the elliptical that keeps your heart rate up and works the whole body.
instructions: Step onto the elliptical and hold the handles.
Start striding in a smooth, ski-like rhythm, swinging your arms with your legs.
Stay upright and keep your core engaged.
Hold a steady pace for your chosen time.
Slow down gradually to finish.

2722.description: Lifting a heavy stone to a platform, building power through the hips and back.
instructions: Straddle the stone and squat down to hug it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to land it on the platform.
Lower the stone under control and reset.

2786.description: Curling the lower back forward, working the abs and mobilising the lumbar spine.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft.
Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2850.description: A lying leg raise with bent knees that makes it easier to focus on the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

2914.description: Walking while holding a barbell locked out overhead. It trains shoulder stability and whole-body bracing.
instructions: Press the barbell overhead with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Walk with small, steady steps, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Cover the set distance without arching your back.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down safely.

2978.description: Moving between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time. It builds the core and shoulders under constant tension.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank with your body in a straight line.
Place one hand on the floor and press up to a high plank.
Place the other hand down.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

3234.description: A flat-bench dumbbell fly done with a wide arc and a stretch across the chest. It isolates the pecs.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对。
将手臂伸直越过胸部，肘部稍微弯曲。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以宽弧线将哑铃向两侧放低，直到感觉到胸部有拉伸感。
暂停片刻，然后反转动作，将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3298.description: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet spread wide apart.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders over your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手与肩同宽，双脚分开。
启动你的核心，慢慢地将你的重心向前移动，将你的肩膀放在你的手上。
弯曲肘部，将身体放低至地面，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，将身体抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3362.description: A close grip press lying down with a cable, putting emphasis on the triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3490.description: A kneeling push-up with the hands on a box, so the body slopes downward. It's an easier push-up that still stresses the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place a sturdy box in front of you and kneel on the floor.
Put your hands on the box edge, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Form a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest to the box with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging.

3554.description: A hammer curl with water bottles as light weights. It trains the biceps and forearms.
instructions: Hold a filled bottle in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl the bottles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

3682.description: Curl dumbbells one at a time while lying back on an incline bench to stretch and work the biceps.
instructions: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging down.
Curl one dumbbell up with the palm facing up.
Lower it slowly.
Curl the other arm.
Keep your upper arms still.

3746.description: A rowing pattern that uses a bed sheet anchored around a door handle or post to work the upper back.
instructions: Loop a bed sheet around a sturdy anchor and hold the ends.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your chest, elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

3874.description: A kneeling hip thrust on the Smith machine that trains hip extension and the glutes.
instructions: Set the bar on the Smith machine at a low height and kneel facing away from it.
Place the bar across your hips with a pad for comfort.
Keep your torso upright and your core braced.
Thrust your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

4002.description: A V up where you crunch your arms and legs together twice. It hits the whole abdominal wall.
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Crunch in again.
Lower with control.
Keep your legs straight.

4066.description: Seated bent over fly done one arm at a time to hit the rear delts.
instructions: Sit at the edge of a bench and lean forward with dumbbells hanging below your knees.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly bent.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.

4130.description: A skullcrusher that mixes a pullover motion, loading the triceps from a long position.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an ez bar above your chest.
Lower the bar toward your forehead.
Let it travel back past your head slightly.
Extend your arms to return.
Keep your upper arms still.

4194.description: A rotator cuff exercise in a half kneeling stance.
instructions: Kneel on one knee beside a cable at elbow height.
Hold the handle with elbow at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward.
Pause.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

4258.description: Running backwards at a comfortable pace. It raises your heart rate and strengthens the quads and calves.
instructions: Find a clear, flat area or treadmill at a low speed.
Stand tall with your arms bent.
Run backwards, landing on the balls of your feet.
Glance over your shoulder from time to time.
Keep a steady, controlled pace.
Slow down gradually to finish.

4322.description: A bodyweight side bend with one arm bent behind your head, working the obliques.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and one hand behind your head, elbow bent.
Place your other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the hand on your hip without leaning forward.
Squeeze your side to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

4386.description: A plank where you lift and extend one leg at a time, testing core stability and strengthening the glutes.
instructions: Get into a forearm or high plank with a flat back.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one leg straight behind you without rotating your hips.
Lower it with control.
Repeat on the other leg and alternate.

4450.description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps with a wide grip. Works the upper back and lats while the core keeps you rigid.
instructions: Hold the handles of a suspension trainer with a wide overhand grip and lean back, arms straight.
Walk your feet forward to set the difficulty.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower yourself with control until your arms are straight.

4578.description: A rope kickback with both arms that targets the triceps through full extension.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold both ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows and spread the rope slightly at the end.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.

4706.description: A jumping combination with a step in the middle to raise your heart rate and train leg power.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Jump up and land softly with bent knees.
Step to the side or forward.
Jump again and land softly.
Keep a steady rhythm.

4770.description: An inverted row with a wide grip. The wide hands shift the work to the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Lie under a bar and grab it with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your body in a straight line, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower under control to straight arms.

4834.description: Alternating dumbbell presses while resting on a stability ball. It builds the chest and trains core balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball holding dumbbells and walk out until your upper back rests on it.
Lift your hips so your body forms a bridge.
Press one dumbbell up over your chest.
Lower it slowly while keeping your hips steady.
Alternate arms for each rep.

4898.description: A lively jump that ends with a kick out to the side. It lifts your heart rate and trains leg power.
instructions: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick one leg out to the side at the top.
Land softly on both feet with soft knees.
Repeat, alternating the kicking leg.
Keep a controlled, bouncy rhythm.

4962.description: A squat to a box behind you. It trains the hips and legs while teaching depth control.
instructions: Place a box behind you and a barbell on your upper back.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

5026.description: Wall slide with a band and a foam roller between your forearms and the wall. It adds stability and serratus activation.
instructions: Put a band around your forearms and place a foam roller on the wall under them.
Press your forearms into the roller and push slightly out against the band.
Roll the roller up the wall as you reach overhead.
Keep your ribs down and shoulders away from your ears.
Roll back down slowly.

5090.description: Pull a cable handle toward your torso from a standing position. It trains the mid-back and teaches a strong, upright posture.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle, stepping back until there is tension.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle toward your ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

5154.description: Step sideways onto a box or step. It works the quads and glutes and builds single-leg strength.
instructions: Stand sideways next to a box.
Place your near foot on the box.
Press through that foot to step up.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

5282.description: From a kneeling position, you drive the landmine bar up into a press. It builds shoulder power.
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar at your chest.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive through your hips and press the bar up.
Straighten your arms fully at the top.
Lower back to your chest with control.

5474.description: Chin-up style pull-up with a close underhand grip that puts extra work on the biceps along with the lats.
instructions: Grip the bar with palms facing you, hands close together.
Hang with arms straight and shoulders pulled down.
Pull your elbows down and in until your chin is above the bar.
Lower under control to full arm extension.
Keep your legs still and avoid swinging.

5666.description: An explosive pull that drives dumbbells up to chest height using the legs and hips. It builds the shoulders and traps and trains power.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dumbbells hanging in front of your thighs.
Bend your knees and hips slightly, keeping your chest up.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and pull the weights up with elbows leading.
Stop at about chest height, elbows above your wrists.
Lower the dumbbells under control and reset.

5858.description: Lie on the floor and open your arms out with kettlebells, stopping when your elbows touch down. It trains the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
Repeat with control.

5986.description: A cone run that builds acceleration, cutting speed and agility.
instructions: Place several cones in a pattern a few yards apart.
Start in an athletic stance.
Sprint or shuffle around the cones in order.
Plant and cut with your hips low.
Finish the course, rest, then go again.

6050.description: A hip bridge with a weighted bottle resting on your hips. It isolates the glutes with light load.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a bottle across your hips with both hands.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6754.description: A side-lying rotation that turns the forearm upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff without weights.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

7202.description: A side lunge with band tension that works the legs and hips from a different angle.
instructions: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

7586.description: A step-up with a cable held on the same side as the working leg, leaning forward to bias the glutes.
instructions: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

8162.description: A flowing stretch from a deep lunge into a straight front leg. It opens the hip flexors and stretches the hamstrings.
instructions: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.

8546.description: A prone sequence of arm positions that strengthens the upper back and shoulder blade muscles.
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead near the floor and arms extended overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms slightly and hold.
Move them out to a T, then bend the elbows into a W.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Reverse the order and repeat.

8610.description: A plank variation held with a modified base that challenges core stability.
instructions: Set up in a plank on your forearms with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Keep your body in one straight line.
Breathe steadily and hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down to rest.

9314.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench that emphasises the glutes. It strengthens the posterior chain.
instructions: Set the pad at hip height and lock your heels in.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Hinge forward at the hips with a straight back.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Lower slowly each rep.

9698.description: A two-arm dumbbell row with your chest on an incline bench. It isolates the back without strain on the lower spine.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

9890.description: A gentle standing move where you tilt and lift the pelvis by squeezing the glutes and abs. It teaches pelvic control and activates the hips.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Tuck your tailbone under and lift the front of your pelvis by squeezing your glutes and lower abs.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.

10594.description: A standing band press that sweeps across the body from the side. It builds chest power and trains the trunk to resist rotation.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

10658.description: Pump your arms against the straps while holding your legs up. It builds core endurance.
instructions: Lie on the carriage holding the straps.
Lift your head and legs.
Pump your arms in small movements.
Breathe in for five counts and out for five.
Continue for 100 pumps.

10850.description: A reformer move where you open and close the legs sideways. It works the inner thighs and balance.
instructions: Stand with one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Brace your core.
Slide the carriage out to widen your stance.
Pause.
Draw it back under control with your inner thighs.
Keep your hips square.

10914.description: A shallow squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. Good for beginners and for warm-ups.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

0034.description: A pullover on a decline bench with slightly bent arms, stretching and working the lats.
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and your feet secured.
Hold a barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Lower the barbell behind your head in a controlled manner, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position by contracting your lats.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，头部低于臀部，双脚固定。
旋前握住杠铃（手掌背向您），并将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
有控制地将杠铃降低到头后，保持手臂稍微弯曲。
暂停片刻，然后收缩背阔肌，将杠铃抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0098.description: A side-to-side lunge with the bar across the back. Strengthens the quads and adductors.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, bending at the knees and hips.
As you lower, push your knees out to the sides and keep your weight on your heels.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开比肩宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌上。
当你将身体降低到蹲姿时，收紧你的核心并保持胸部向上，弯曲膝盖和臀部。
当你下降时，将膝盖向两侧推出，并将体重保持在脚后跟上。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，然后通过脚后跟推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0162.description: A cable front raise. Works the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the cable handle with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Raise the cable handle in front of you, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Continue lifting until your arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住电缆手柄。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将电缆手柄举到您面前，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
继续抬起，直到手臂与地板平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将拉索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0226.description: A standing cable crunch with the rope held behind the head. You round the torso down toward the knees to work the abs.
instructions: Attach a cable handle to a high pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Hold the handle with both hands and place it behind your head, keeping your elbows bent.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keeping your abs engaged, exhale and crunch your torso down towards your knees, bringing your elbows towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆手柄连接到高滑轮上，并背对机器站立。
双手握住手柄并将其放在脑后，保持肘部弯曲。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
保持腹肌收紧，呼气，将躯干压向膝盖，将肘部拉向大腿。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0290.description: A seated dumbbell press on a bench with back support. It targets the shoulders and the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lean back and position the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，每只手各拿一个哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后倾斜，将哑铃放在胸部两侧，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0354.description: A bent-over, one-arm movement where you straighten the elbow behind you. It isolates the triceps, especially at the top of the squeeze.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in your right hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your right elbow up to your side, keeping it bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your right arm straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将右肘举至身体一侧，保持弯曲 90 度角。
将右臂向后伸直，在动作的最高点挤压三头肌。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0418.description: Standing and leaning slightly forward, you curl a dumbbell with your elbow against your inner thigh. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, with your arm fully extended and palm facing inwards.
Place your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一手握住哑铃，手臂完全伸展，手掌朝内。
将另一只手放在大腿上以获得支撑。
保持上臂静止，呼气，通过收缩二头肌将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0482.description: A reverse-crunch style move lifting the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and lifted over your hips.
Place your hands at your sides.
Curl your hips off the floor by bringing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Use your abs instead of swinging your legs.

0546.description: Seated on a bench, you press a kettlebell in each hand overhead. Takes the legs out so your shoulders and triceps do the work.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the kettlebells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the kettlebells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个壶铃，与肩同高，手掌朝前。
将壶铃压过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将壶铃降低至肩膀高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0610.description: Jumping jacks performed from a squat position. They raise your heart rate and burn the legs.
instructions: Start in a half squat with hands in front of your chest.
Jump your feet out wide, staying low.
Jump them back together and keep your knees bent.
Keep your chest up and weight on your heels.
Stay in the squat throughout.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

0674.description: A pull-up with an underhand grip. Puts extra emphasis on the biceps along with the lats.
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双手分开与肩同宽，反握抓住引体向上杆。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
调动背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃杆，以胸部为主导。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0738.description: On a 45 degree sled, you press the platform with your toes. Isolates the calves.
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward.
Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将雪橇机调整至 45 度角。
将脚放在雪橇平台上，脚趾朝前。
伸展脚踝和小腿，将雪橇平台推离您。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将雪橇平台放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0866.description: A hanging leg raise with added weight. It builds the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或稍高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0930.description: A standing row with a band. It works the mid-back and lats.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull your elbows back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

0994.description: A reverse wrist curl with a band, lifting the back of the hands. It strengthens the forearms.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and wrap it around your fingers.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住弹力带，手掌朝下，然后将其缠绕在手指上。
将前臂放在大腿上，手腕悬在边缘上。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，挤压前臂。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
